
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/KK3228911/p/19634183" title="发布于 2026-02-24 16:34">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">教你一招解决百度统计被恶意刷量和关键字的办法</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>做站的每年总会遇到各种各样的攻击，比如统计被恶意刷关键字刷量的事情，大多是那些做灰产刷广告或诈骗的人。</p>
<p><img alt="Snipaste_2026-02-24_16-11-40" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/508139/202602/508139-20260224161053676-861576796.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>今天来分享一招解决百度统计被刷的事，这种通常是通过访问你<span style="text-decoration: underline">网站URL+参数</span>的方式，例如：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">https://www.xxx.com/index.html<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">?ad=</span>3.nuoya%E8%93%</pre>
</div>
<p>那么我们只需要配置网站的 <strong>URL重写(Rewrite)规则</strong>，<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">拦截拒绝</span>这类的访问请求即可。</p>
<p>常规网站程序都配置有 web.config 文件，可以将拦截规则写在这里；或是在 web_config/rewrite.config 里写的，二者按个人情况选其一即可。</p>
<p><strong>web.config 的写法如下(在 rewrite 内增加 rules)：</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;?</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">?&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configuration</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">location </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">path</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="."</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> allowOverride</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="false"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> inheritInChildApplications</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="false"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system.webServer</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rewrite</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拦截所有包含 ad= 的查询参数的请求 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rule </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Block malicious ad parameter"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> stopProcessing</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="true"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">match </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">=".*"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">conditions</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">add </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{QUERY_STRING}"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> pattern</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ad="</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">conditions</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">action </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="CustomResponse"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> statusCode</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="403"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> subStatusCode</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="0"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> statusReason</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Forbidden"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> statusDescription</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Forbidden"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rule</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rules</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rewrite</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 以下是你原有的外部配置文件引用，保持不变即可 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">defaultDocument </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">configSource</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="web_config\default.config"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">httpErrors </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">configSource</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="web_config\httpErrors.config"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">handlers </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">configSource</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="web_config\php.config"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system.webServer</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">location</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configuration</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>web_config/rewrite.config 的写法如下(增加 rule 标签段)：</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ===== 新增规则：拦截包含恶意参数 ad= 的请求 ===== </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rule </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Block_Malicious_Ad_Parameter"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> stopProcessing</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="true"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">match </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">url</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">=".*"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">conditions</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">add </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{QUERY_STRING}"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> pattern</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ad="</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">conditions</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">action </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="CustomResponse"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> statusCode</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="403"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> statusReason</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Forbidden"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> statusDescription</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Access Denied"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rule</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>如果想拦截多个参数的，可以在&lt;conditions&gt;标签内再增加，如：</p>
<p>&lt;add input="{QUERY_STRING}" pattern="click=" /&gt;</p>
<p>&lt;add input="{QUERY_STRING}" pattern="from=" /&gt;</p>
<p>最后，保存配置后，重启服务器即可生效，这时发现百度统计已恢复正常，并且这种带“?ad=”的参数访问直接被拦截访问了，同时也是减轻服务器的带宽消耗。</p>

</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
